Prices for the stay of Nov 5 to 7, 2026, as listed on October 1, 2026.

18 Colombo hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on October 1, 2026 for Nov 5 to Nov 7, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Colombo hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 1, 2026 snapshot, at 17 of the 18 Colombo hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Priceline at 4, Qantas Hotels at 2, Traveluro at 2, Trip.com at 2, Amimir.com at 1, Billabook.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, Catchit.com at 1 and 3 other sites at 3 between them. Taxes and fees at Colombo hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 22% ($20 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 19% at Marino Beach Colombo to 34% at Cinnamon Red Colombo. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
